basics.name: Santiago Martinez
basics.label: Senior Data Scientist / AI Engineer
basics.summary: Senior Data Scientist and AI Engineer with a PhD in Deep Learning and 5+ years of experience building large-scale data processing systems, machine learning pipelines, and deep neural network models on distributed GPU infrastructure. Proven track record delivering measurable improvements in model performance and data efficiency across 10TB+ datasets. Strong expertise in production ML systems, feature engineering, scalable architectures, LLMs, NLP, and generative AI workflows.

work.name: Laboratoire Astroparticule et Cosmologie (APC)
work.position: Project Chief, ML/AI, Deep Learning & Data Engineering
work.summary: Led machine learning, deep learning, and data engineering activities for large-scale scientific analyses.
highlights: Designed and trained 10+ deep neural network models, including Graph Neural Networks, improving parameter estimation accuracy by 12–25% on large-scale scientific datasets.
Built and optimized end-to-end machine learning pipelines processing 10+ TB of distributed data, reducing preprocessing time by 40% through parallelization, vectorization, and I/O optimization.
Developed scalable data engineering workflows on HPC clusters using CPU and GPU resources, enabling efficient model training and inference across distributed systems.
Implemented feature engineering and data transformation pipelines, improving model generalization and stability under domain shifts.
Co-led an international team of 10+ researchers, delivering production-grade statistical models for multi-experiment analyses.
Worked as a visiting researcher at King's College London.
Applied advanced neural network architectures and domain adaptation techniques, with applications transferable to LLM training, fine-tuning, and large-scale AI systems.
